design_rationale:
WORKLOG task 0 — balloon_maturity_and_title (env_0066), returned-vehicle settlement tree.

[Step 0 draw] draw_counts.py --task 0 -> {"prerequisite_problems": 3, "problems": 4, "factor_counts": [5, 5, 6, 6]}. Assignment: balloon_ext_return_mileage_charge 6, balloon_ext_return_wear_charge 6, balloon_ext_return_fee 5, balloon_ext_return_balance_plan 5 (multiset {5,5,6,6} matches). Task 1 draw (headroom check): 2 prerequisite problems, factor counts [5, 6, 5].
[Scope snapshot] Occupied before this task: nothing (first task). Claimed here: the four return-side policies above and the tools bill_excess_mileage_charge_7a491561, bill_excess_wear_charge_ce1b5dd4, bill_return_fee_2252d2f2 (agent) and pay_return_balance_installment_2f123e0a (user). Left for task 1: the maturity/refinance side — payoff quote (balloon_payoff_quote), the pre-refinance payment (balloon_payment on an active contract) and the balloon refinance (balloon_refinance / balloon_terms_modified) — three unclaimed problems with their own tools, which fits task 1's draw of 2 prerequisites. No policy, route or tool is reserved idle.
[Design thesis] Surface goal: a customer who turned her balloon vehicle in under the return option wants "the smallest payment Kestrel will take on it today under whatever payment plan you offer". Scored core: the return balance payment under the Kestrel return balance plan (355.25). Hidden between goal and core: the three return charges are not billed yet (state_due obligations of the base return rule once the 14-day dispute period has run), and the plan payment is fixed only after each stands billed. Depth: 2 hops (goal -> plan payment -> three charges). Breadth: 22 load-bearing factors over the return inspection, 47 ledger rows (late charges, a returned payment, autopay history, the return election), the contract dates and tier, and three other product lines (an active Kestrel lease, a closed Kestrel retail contract, no pre-owned contract). Why a good test: the agent must (a) read the plan rule's three prerequisite sentences, see in the ledger that no return charge stands billed, and find in the other rules which write books each; (b) compute three charges whose base formulas are each replaced by a schedule (odometer selection, early-return proration, tolerance, loyalty, election credit, rate reductions, forgiveness, credits, share, fee basis and reductions); (c) only then compute the plan payment from the billed totals; (d) hand the payment to the customer. Difficulty comes from reading policy, querying the world and computing; every tool is named by its policy's target_tool, so nothing is tool-guessing.

[Problem-tree card]
root: balloon_ext_return_balance_plan (owner=user tool pay_return_balance_installment_2f123e0a).
edge 1: root -> balloon_ext_return_mileage_charge; kind value_input; gate mileage_billed; form state; sentence "The return balance payment is fixed only after the excess mileage charge for the return stands billed on the contract." (affirmative). condition: a balloon_return_charge entry of fee_type excess_mileage_charge stands on the contract. Resolved by bill_excess_mileage_charge_7a491561 (owner agent). Only that tool books an excess_mileage_charge entry in this difficulty, so the state singles out one write.
edge 2: root -> balloon_ext_return_wear_charge; value_input; gate wear_billed; state; "The return balance payment is not fixed until the excess wear charge for the return stands billed on the contract." (negated direction; exact contrapositive of "fixed only after"). Resolved by bill_excess_wear_charge_ce1b5dd4 (agent), the only writer of excess_wear_charge entries.
edge 3: root -> balloon_ext_return_fee; value_input; gate fee_billed; state; "Before the return balance payment is fixed, the return fee for the return must stand billed on the contract." Resolved by bill_return_fee_2252d2f2 (agent), the only writer of return_fee entries.
Four-point test, each sentence: explicit connective (only after / not until / before ... must); the waited-on side is a record-visible state (a billed charge entry of a named kind), no action or performer; no tool, policy id, snake_case token or row id (the kinds are named in words: excess mileage charge, excess wear charge, return fee); strength exactly the edge (one kind per sentence, hard requirement). Directions mix (2 affirmative, 1 negated) as a billing desk would say a figure "is fixed only after"/"is not fixed until" the bill it rests on stands. Derivation for a reader: sentence + find_balloon_transactions (no balloon_return_charge rows; inspection row present) + the mileage rule ("This rule sets the excess mileage charge billed once a balloon vehicle has come back under the return option and the return inspection is on file.") -> the mileage-charge write; likewise wear and fee.
Why false at frozen_time: initial_state.balloon_transactions holds 47 rows, none of event_type balloon_return_charge; balloon_contracts.<B>.fees_due_balance = 25.0 (the 2025-12-06 late charge alone). Flips: steps 8/10/12 book 623.20 / 179.66 / 205.00 and fees_due_balance becomes 1032.86.
Topological order: mileage, wear, fee (any order among them), then the plan payment. Parallel edges commute: none of the three charge computations reads fees_due_balance or a return-charge row (verified: each recomputes identically whatever subset of the other two is billed), and each writes its own fee_type row, so all six orders give the same terminal state.
Deletion sensitivity (harness run, other two charges billed): skip mileage -> plan payment 194.83; skip wear -> 416.60; skip fee -> 403.93 (gold 355.25); and the terminal DB lacks the skipped charge entry.
user_scenario names no charge, no billing and nothing "to sort out first"; the only related line is a passive reaction that fires after the agent says something must be put on the account. Tools validate no prerequisite: the payment tool posts whatever amount it is given with no look at the charges; the billing tools book any amount without checking the inspection, dispute period or each other.

[Base-invariant card]
Subject balloon_return_charge (steps 8, 10, 12) — governing base policy balloon_vehicle_return only.
 - charge_status (state, system_record): "Return charges can be billed only while the contract status is returned." Evidence balloon_contracts.<B>.status = returned; correlation key balloon_contract_id = the billed contract. Satisfied.
 - dispute_elapsed (time): "Return charges may be billed only after return_inspection_dispute_days have fully elapsed from the date the vehicle was returned." Anchor event: the vehicle was returned; anchor_source balloon_contracts.return_date = 2026-09-18; duration variants.return_inspection_dispute_days = 14 (Tier 3); counting: calendar days from the day after return_date, billing permitted from return_date + 14 + 1 day = 2026-10-03; relation not_before, boundary exclusive. Just before: 2026-10-02 (not permitted). At boundary: 2026-10-03 permitted. Frozen 2026-10-14: permitted. No dispute request exists (no balloon_requests rows), so nothing awaits resolution.
 - return_allowed / return_deadline apply to balloon_vehicle_returned (the return itself, done 2026-09-18 before the call: return 7 days before maturity, inside the 30-day window; days_past_due 0; return_option_available true).
Subject balloon_payment (step 14) — governing base policies balloon_payment_posting and balloon_reinstatement_and_redemption (both list balloon_payment).
 - payable_status ("A payment can be posted only while the contract status is active, repo_assigned, repossessed or deficiency.") is retired for this payment only, by the declared overwrite of balloon_ext_return_balance_plan; every other clause of the posting rule stays: allocation order (on a returned contract principal is 0.00, so nothing accrues and the whole amount goes to fees due), channel fee (phone_ivr_ach: 0.00), certified-funds clause (certified_funds_only_until empty).
 - reinstatement_and_redemption: its gates apply to balloon_reinstated only; policy_scope recorded (contract never repossessed, repossession_type none).
[Business-object card] Target object: the one balloon contract 4071583926 (Tier 3, returned 2026-09-18). Correlation key: balloon_contract_id on every charge and payment entry. Rows included: the return inspection of 2026-09-18 (odometer 41236, wear 1386.40), the contract fields, the late charges (2024-10-06, 2025-12-06), the returned payment 2025-06-29, 35 installment payments, the 2026-08-20 return election. Excluded by rule: the inspection row's excess_miles 5227 (vendor's raw base-formula figure; no rule reads it), the 2024-10-06 late charge from 24-month counts (24 months 8 days old), the 2025-06-29 returned payment from 12-month counts (15 months old). Settled objects: the 2024-10-06 late charge was paid with the 2024-10-25 payment (fee payment entry), the returned-payment fee with the 2025-07-02 payment; the 2025-12-06 late charge (25.00) still stands and is the "fees standing from before the return".

[Overwrite declarations — hygiene]
- mileage: retires base clause "excess_miles is the inspection odometer less ... and is charged at return_excess_mileage_rate per mile." replaced_by names its scope ("For the excess mileage charge billed on a returned balloon contract, and only for that charge") and carries the still-in-force parts (excess never below zero, charge = excess x rate) and says the rest of the return rule stays.
- wear: retires "The excess wear charge is wear_assessed_amount less return_wear_waiver_cap for the tier, never below zero."; replaced_by keeps "never below zero" and "the wear_assessed_amount ... remains the amount the charge starts from", scoped to the wear charge.
- return fee: retires "The return fee is return_option_fee for the tier, waived when ... within return_fee_loyalty_days ..."; replaced_by keeps the tier fee and the 30-day waiver verbatim in substance and adds the fee basis/reductions, scoped to the return fee.
- plan: retires payable_status for a return balance payment on a returned contract only (tail keeps every other payment under the base sentence, quoted), and retires "charges are due return_charges_due_days calendar days after billing" for charges placed on a plan only (tail keeps the 30-day due date for unplanned charges, the closing on payment and the charge-off at return_charge_off_days). Each overwrite retires a clause whose provision differs in this world (base mileage 1306.75 vs 623.20; base wear 1136.40 vs 179.66; base fee 450.00 vs 205.00; base payment would be refused on a returned contract and the whole 1032.86 due in 30 days).

[Factor cards — every factor off its fall-through, figures from the harness run on the handling-time world]
Mileage charge (gold 623.20; baseline_result with every factor at its baseline 1306.75 = (41236 - 9 - 36000) x 0.25):
 1 mc_odometer_reading (method; history/contract): sign-in 41198 vs inspection 41236, gap 38 in 1..100 -> lower reading; tier "differ by 1..tolerance". Baseline (inspection odometer) -> 630.80. Near-miss: the inspection row's own excess_miles 5227 tempts a reader to bill 5227 x 0.25.
 2 mc_allowance_basis (method; date): returned before maturity -> 36000 x 1103/1110 = 35773. Baseline full-term 36000 -> 577.80.
 3 mc_tolerance_miles (parameter; multi-source: tier AND late-charge count; round 2: both rungs now allow at most one late charge, so a better tier never fares worse than a weaker one on the same record): Tier 3 AND one late charge in 24 months -> 500. Baseline 0 -> 723.20. Near-miss: 2024-10-06 late charge is 24 months 8 days old (outside), else the count would be 2 and the tier would fall through.
 4 mc_return_to_brand (parameter; cross-difficulty lease): lease dated 41 days before the return (within 60) -> 1500. Baseline 0 -> 923.20.
 5 mc_advance_election (parameter; history): return election 36 days before maturity -> 300. Baseline 0 -> 683.20.
 6 mc_rate_relationship (parameter; cross-difficulty retail): closed retail contract -> rate 0.25 - 0.05. Baseline 0.25 -> 779.00.
Wear charge (gold 179.66; baseline 1136.40 = 1386.40 - 250.00):
 1 wc_standing_forgiveness (parameter; multi-source: tier AND returned-payment count AND payment count): Tier 3, no returned payment in 12 months, 11 payments posted -> tier cap 250.00 plus standing bonus 250.00 = 500.00 (round 2: the rung is now cap + bonus, so no tier's clean rung is below its own fall-through). Baseline Tier 3 cap 250.00 -> 365.99. Near-miss: the 2025-06-29 returned payment is 15 months old.
 2 wc_forgiveness_proration (method; date): early return -> x 1103/1110 = 496.85. Baseline unprorated -> 177.30.
 3 wc_return_to_brand (parameter; cross lease): -> 400.00. Baseline 0 -> 479.66.
 4 wc_tenure_credit (parameter; cross retail): retail signed 2016-04-02, 10.4 years -> 150.00. Baseline 0 -> 292.16.
 5 wc_ontime_credit (parameter; history): 9 whole months from 2025-11-25 to 2026-09-18 -> 100.00. Baseline 0 -> 254.66. Near-miss: counting from the late charge's own date 2025-12-06 also gives 9; counting to the billing date 2026-10-14 would give 10 — the rule anchors at the return date.
 6 wc_share_billed (parameter; multi-source tier AND late count; round 2: both rungs allow at most one late charge): Tier 3, one late charge in 12 months -> 0.75. Baseline whole -> 239.55.
Return fee (gold 205.00; baseline 450.00):
 1 fc_fee_basis (method; cross lease): no contract within 30 days, lease within 90 -> lower of 450.00 and 395.00. Baseline tier fee -> 260.00. Near-miss: a reader applying the base 30-day waiver to the 41-day-old lease bills 0.00.
 2 fc_early_return (parameter; date): 7 days early -> 75.00. Baseline 0 -> 280.00.
 3 fc_multi_line (parameter; cross lease/retail/preowned): one active line -> 50.00. Baseline 0 -> 255.00. Near-miss: the closed retail contract is not an active line.
 4 fc_payment_record (parameter; multi-source late AND returned counts): one late, no returned in 12 months -> 25.00. Baseline 0 -> 230.00.
 5 fc_autopay_record (parameter; history): 10 autopay payments in 12 months -> 40.00. Baseline 0 -> 245.00. Near-miss: the 2025-12-09 online payment is not autopay.
Return balance payment (gold 355.25; baseline 1032.86 = whole fees due):
 1 rp_plan_length (method): Tier 3, no returned payment in 12 months -> int(1007.86/300) = 3 installments -> 335.953. Baseline one payment -> 1010.36.
 2 rp_prior_fee_share (parameter): a late charge in 12 months but none in 6 -> 0.5 of 25.00. Baseline all -> 367.75.
 3 rp_minimum_share (parameter; multi-source late count 24m AND returned count 12m; round 2 ladder: two or more late charges or a returned payment in 12 months -> 0.50; exactly one late charge and no returned payment in 12 months -> 0.35; clean -> none): one late charge, no returned payment in 12 months -> 0.35 x 1007.86 = 352.751 > 335.953. Baseline none -> 338.45.
 4 rp_relationship_deferral (parameter; cross lease): lease at days_past_due 0, no active retail -> 50.00 deferred. Baseline 0 -> 405.25.
 5 rp_upfront_amount (parameter; history): returned payment 2025-06-29 within 24 months, not 12 -> +40.00. Baseline 0 -> 315.25.
Task floors: multi-source factors 6 (mc_tolerance_miles, wc_standing_forgiveness, wc_share_billed, fc_payment_record, rp_minimum_share, rp_plan_length); cross-difficulty factors 7 (lease x5, retail x2); every computation reads a cross value (CFIELD lease_date / disposition_fee / days_past_due / retail contract_date).
[Factor independence table] Each factor's bindings read only records, parameters and plain shared reads, never another factor's binding: mc_* read insp row, return_odometer, dates, late-charge COUNT, lease/retail CFIELD/EXISTS, election LATEST; plain bindings miles_driven, per_mile_rate, excess_miles, result assemble. wc_* read inspection wear (plain wear_assessed), returned/payment/late COUNTs, dates, lease/retail CFIELD; forgiveness_applied (plain) multiplies the standing forgiveness by the proration share — assembly, not a factor reading a factor. fc_* each read their own records; result subtracts. rp_* read the billed-charge SUMs (plain return_charges, prior_fees shared once), COUNTs and lease/retail days_past_due; charges_now (plain) takes the larger of the spread part and the minimum share; result adds/subtracts. Transitively no factor's tier depends on another factor's output.
[Method tier pairwise tables] mc_odometer_reading: lower-of vs sign-in differ when sign-in > inspection by <=100 (e.g. 41236/41198 swapped); lower-of vs inspection differ when sign-in lower (this world); sign-in vs inspection differ whenever the gap > 0. mc_allowance_basis: prorated vs extension-months differ for any contract with extensions (36000x1103/1110 vs 37000 for one extension); prorated vs full-term differ whenever return_date != maturity_date; extension vs full-term differ when extensions_used_lifetime > 0. wc_forgiveness_proration: same three shapes on the forgiveness. fc_fee_basis: waived (0) vs lower-of differ whenever either fee > 0; lower-of vs tier fee differ when the lease disposition_fee < tier fee (395 < 450 here); waived vs tier fee differ always. rp_plan_length: balance-driven vs fixed 2 differ when the count is 3 or 4 (1007.86 -> 3); balance-driven vs one payment differ always (count >= 2); fixed 2 vs one payment differ always.

[Edge-probe table (scratch copies, harness)] Reads and decoys:
 - LATEST return inspection (mileage, wear): added an older inspection row 2026-09-10 (odometer 41000, wear 900.00) -> 623.20 / 179.66 unchanged (latest by txn_date governs). Absent inspection: the rules start "from the return inspection on file"; with none the charge rules have nothing to bill from (no seed case).
 - CFIELD lease lease_date / disposition_fee / days_past_due (status='active'): inserted a closed lease dated 2026-09-20 ahead of the real one -> all unchanged (status filter). Absent lease -> mileage 923.20, wear 479.66, fee 310.00 (each falls to its no-lease tier, as the rules state). Two active leases would make "an active Kestrel lease" first-match; the world has exactly one.
 - CFIELD retail contract_date (status closed / paid_in_full) and EXISTS retail/preowned: added a charged_off pre-owned contract dated 2026-09-25 -> unchanged (charged_off is neither active nor completed).
 - LATEST return_vehicle election: added a pay_balloon election 2026-07-01 -> 623.20 unchanged (filter maturity_option=return_vehicle). Absent election -> lead -1 -> no credit (rule: "or no return election was recorded").
 - COUNT late charges / returned payments / payments / autopay: removing every late charge -> mileage 623.20, wear 179.66, fee 155.00 (fee moves to the clean tier, as stated). LATEST late-charged installment absent -> "no balloon late charge has ever been assessed" -> top on-time tier (stated).
 - Zero-division / None: term_days > 0 for any booked contract; plan count held >= 2; return_odometer and maturity_date are set on every returned contract; CFIELD reads are guarded by EXISTS.
[compute_basis sweep] harness basis_sweep: every compute_basis quotation, every baseline.rule sentence, every replaced_by and every policy_source is a verbatim substring of its own rule — "basis sweep misses: 0". Reverse sweep: every rule sentence carrying a quantity, window, branch, floor/ceiling or rounding is claimed (odometer tolerance, proration days, 24/12/6-month windows, 60/30/90-day spans, election leads, rate reductions, wear credits, share, fee reductions, plan count bounds, minimum share, deferral, upfront, never-below-zero, never-above-fees_due, rounding to the cent at the end).
[Seed design] customers: one row (band: phone 3135544718, tax 4372, ZIP 49007, street 417 W Lovell St, Kalamazoo MI). balloon_contracts: one Tier 3 contract, account 4071583926, VIN 3KSBD4A23PN412683 (check digit computed, serial 412683). balloon_transactions (47): funding 41980.00 on 2023-09-11; 35 installment payments of 783.98 posted on simple interest at 8.99%/365 (interest from the prior paid-to date, then principal, then fees), autopay except 2024-10-08 and 2025-12-09 (online, late) and 2025-07-02 (phone, re-payment); returned autopay 2025-06-25 (returned 2025-06-29, insufficient_funds) with a 25.00 returned-payment fee paid on 2025-07-02; late charges 25.00 on 2024-10-06 (paid with the 2024-10-25 payment) and 2025-12-06 (unpaid, = fees_due_balance 25.00); maturity options letter 2026-06-27 (90 days before maturity); return election 2026-08-20; return credit 23470.36 on 2026-09-18 (principal at return; balloon_amount 23446.50 differs because two installments were late); return inspection 2026-09-18. lease_contracts: Kestrel Lease Tier 2, account 4203917548, VIN 5KSLE7B37TN438051, dated 2026-08-08, 36 months, money factor 0.00215 (Tier 2 0.00195 sheet plus markup within 0.0004), residual 22779.50 (58%), purchase option fee 350.00, base payment 520.84 + 6% use tax 31.25, 2 payments made, 34 remaining, next due 2026-11-08, days_past_due 0, disposition_fee 395.00 (Tier 2 standard). retail_contracts: Tier 2, account 4118260437, VIN 1KSRA2C4XGN427719, 60 months at 7.99 (Tier 2 49-60 band), installment 438.68, 2016-04-02 to paid in full 2021-03-29, closed 2021-04-01. Why each class exists: the inspection, dates and tier feed every charge; late/returned/autopay/election rows decide the history tiers and the near-misses; the lease and retail rows decide the cross-difficulty tiers. Automatic clauses checked: no late charge accrues on a returned contract; the 120-day charge-off is far off (2027-01-16); the base overpayment refund cannot fire (principal is 0.00, not negative); the lease and retail rows are current/closed and ignite nothing in their own difficulties.
[Persona design] Delia Prescott, brisk, tired surgical nurse on her lunch break. Volunteers only the surface goal (smallest payment today on the turned-in car under a plan) and the true opening fact that she returned the car on September 18. Gives the phone number to be located, phone + SSN last four + ZIP to verify (DOB as a spare), the account number and her other Kestrel holdings only when asked, and says she does not know mileage, inspection or charge figures. Passive reactions: agrees when told something must be put on the account first; refuses a lump sum and repeats the plan request if offered the total; runs the handed-over payment with the stated amount and the account ending 4419; ends after confirmation. She never names a charge, never proposes a figure and never corrects the agent.
[Tool capability cards] bill_excess_mileage_charge_7a491561 / bill_excess_wear_charge_ce1b5dd4 / bill_return_fee_2252d2f2 (agent, write): one balloon_return_charge entry of fee_type excess_mileage_charge / excess_wear_charge / return_fee dated today for the given amount (USD, cents), fees_due_balance += amount; receipt: entry id, type, amount, billing date, new fees due. Triggers: none (fees_due account, balloon category only). pay_return_balance_installment_2f123e0a (user, write): one balloon_payment dated today, channel phone_ivr_ach, purpose installment, fees_applied = amount, interest/principal 0.00, plus its balloon_fee_payment entry (the base trigger for a non-zero fee portion, same category), fees_due_balance -= amount, last_payment_date = today; receipt: payment id, amount, date, channel, account last four, remaining fees due. purpose installment triggers no reinstatement/redemption/paid-in-full transition.

[Standard solution] 0 find_customers(phone 3135544718) -> 1 verify (phone, 4372, 49007; 3 matches) -> 2 find_balloon_contracts -> 3 find_balloon_transactions (sees no return charge billed; reads inspection, late charges, returned payment, payments, election) -> 4 find_lease_contracts -> 5 find_retail_contracts -> 6 find_preowned_contracts -> 7/8 unlock+call mileage charge 623.20 -> 9/10 unlock+call wear charge 179.66 -> 11/12 unlock+call return fee 205.00 -> 13 unlock_user_discoverable_tool + 14 customer calls pay_return_balance_installment_2f123e0a(amount 355.25, funding_account_last4 4419). Terminal: three return charge entries, one payment and one fee payment entry; fees_due_balance 677.61.
[Verification run] Scratch harness (/tmp/balloon_maturity_and_title_0066/harness.py) evaluates each compute with check_compute's own evaluator on the world after the preceding gold writes (simulated with the real tools): mileage 623.20 (baseline 1306.75), wear 179.66 (1136.40), fee 205.00 (450.00), plan payment 355.25 (1032.86); per-factor sensitivities as listed in the factor cards; prerequisite sensitivity 194.83 / 416.60 / 403.93. Gates (per task 0): EXTENDED OK, TASK TOOL CONTRACT OK, REPLAY OK (15 actions, deterministic, closure 51 = init 51), SOLVABILITY OK, COMPUTE OK (4 comps, 22 factors, 7 cross, 33 history rows, 104 branches), GROUNDING OK, SCOPE OK.
[Closure] policy -> tool -> computation step/arg -> GT call -> terminal: mileage -> bill_excess_mileage_charge_7a491561 -> step 8 amount -> entry 623.20; wear -> bill_excess_wear_charge_ce1b5dd4 -> step 10 -> 179.66; fee -> bill_return_fee_2252d2f2 -> step 12 -> 205.00; plan -> pay_return_balance_installment_2f123e0a -> step 14 -> payment 355.25. charter_scope.extended_policies = required_documents = computations.policy_id = the 4 problems; task_tools in first-call order. solvability_contract: steps 8/10/12 cite charge_status (status returned) and dispute_elapsed (return_date 2026-09-18 + frozen_time) bound to balloon_contract_id; step 14 cites the retired payable-status gate as policy_scope and the reinstatement policy_scope, intent from the customer's verbatim opening line, stage established by prior steps 8/10/12.
[Real-conversation walk] Opening line states object (the turned-in Corvalis' final bill), timing (today), mode (she pays herself, under a plan). Agent locates and verifies, reads the contract (returned), the ledger (no charges billed; dispute period over since 2026-10-03), finds the plan rule's three sentences, explains the charges must be billed first; Delia agrees. Agent bills the three charges, figures the plan payment, unlocks and hands the payment tool over with 355.25; Delia runs it from the account ending 4419 and the receipt enters the transcript; she thanks and ends. Every must-ask item (identity, account, other Kestrel cars, which account to draw) has a scripted answer; nothing waits on a real-world event (the return and inspection completed on 2026-09-18).
[Draft recomputation from visible context] With yaml/compute/expected hidden: the published plan rule says the payment is fixed only after the three charges stand billed; the ledger shows none; the charge rules give, from the inspection, contract and other holdings, 623.20 / 179.66 / 205.00; the plan rule then gives 3 installments (1007.86/300 rounded down), the 0.35 minimum share (352.751 > 335.953), half of the 25.00 earlier late charge, 50.00 deferred for the current lease, 40.00 upfront for the 2025 returned payment: 355.25. Matches gold; no second reading found (the only rounding happens on the final figures; 179.6625 and 355.251 are not half-cent ties).

[Headroom/coverage at close] Task 0 covers 4 of the 7 extended policies, task 1 the other 3; scopes, tools and required_documents are disjoint; every policy fires in exactly one task's computations.


REWORK round 2 (audit policy_task r1: task 0 PASS; charter C-F1 members 1-3 sit in this task's policies; observations)
- C-F1 member 1 (wc_standing_forgiveness): rungs are now the tier's own return_wear_waiver_cap plus a standing bonus (250 for Tier 3 and better, 150 for Tier 4/5), so the clean rung is never at or below the fall-through for any tier (Tier 1: 750 vs 500; Tier 1+: 1000 vs 750).
- C-F1 member 2 (rp_minimum_share): risk-ordered ladder over distinct records — two or more late charges in 24 months or a returned payment in 12 months -> 0.50; exactly one late charge and no returned payment in 12 months -> 0.35; clean -> none.
